title: Install Pocock's Skills
description: Shell loop to download six skills from Matt Pocock's repository at a pinned commit for reproducibility.

steps.description: Pinning: P variable set to specific commit hash for reproducibility.
Skill list: six skills from productivity and engineering folders with their files.
Destination: d variable computes skill path, mkdir -p creates it, curl downloads each file.
License: curl downloads LICENSE to LICENSE-mattpocock-skills.txt.
